description:
Litter-Robot 4 companion: full history and pet alerts, kept on your phone

Meowstache is an independent companion app for the Litter-Robot 4. Your cat, your robot, your data.

Features

  • Full history: week, month, year and all-time charts for weight, visits and cleaning cycles, kept on your phone so it outlives the server's retention.
  • Pet alerts: no litter box visit in N days, too many visits in 24 hours, target weight crossed, unusual patterns, and a daily recap.
  • Insights: daily recap, visit duration, time of visit and pattern detection, computed on your phone.
  • Robot status and controls: waste and litter levels, activity log, lights, cycle delay, panel lock and more.
  • Robot notifications: drawer full, low litter, cycle finished or interrupted, errors, offline robot, firmware updates.
  • Backup and restore of your full history to a file.
  • Demo mode: try the app with a made-up robot and cats, no account needed.

Privacy: you sign in with your Litter-Robot account. Your password goes straight to the official login server and is never stored; the login token is encrypted with the Android Keystore. No analytics, no ads, no third-party servers.

Cloud note: cloud mode uses Whisker's unofficial, reverse-engineered cloud API, which may break at any time, and Whisker's terms of use do not permit third-party clients. Local mode (Home Assistant plus community firmware) avoids Whisker's servers entirely.

Please note: Meowstache is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer, and it doesn't replace the official app (setup and some settings still need it). Only the Litter-Robot 4 is supported. The app depends on the manufacturer's proprietary cloud service. It is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind.

Litter-Robot, SmartScale and LitterHopper are trademarks of Whisker (Automated Pet Care Products, LLC); other names are trademarks of their owners. Meowstache is not affiliated with or endorsed by Whisker.
